description: Your wallet's wins, as the site's prizes page reads them: { wins, link, evmAddress }, the newest first. Each win: mint, symbol, number (its round), skin (the prize), state (drawn: waiting for you; buying, sent, delivered; owed_sol, paid_sol; forfeited), stateText, linkDeadline (claim by then), keep (the coins you must still hold to claim, raw units), and its kind's details (goods, gift, stars, trip, stock, nft, evm, offer, pack). solOffer, when not null, is what claim_sol pays: bps of its worth, and lamports. An xStocks prize (stock) not claimed yet can be taken at its full worth in SOL. Every other claim (a shipping address, a gift card's code, a Steam trade link, a hotel) is on souvenir.finance/prizes. Takes the token from sign_in (sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with the wallet, sign_in), as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Wins through the API are not open yet." while they are not open to your wallet, as launching is.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
